question_answers.notes: Thai name Raththawi (ราชเทวี). App unit = nearest-stop catchment within 800 m straight-line of BTS Ratchathewi (N1, Sukhumvit Line) at the Ratchathewi intersection (Phetchaburi x Phaya Thai roads), 100% in Ratchathewi khet but only ~11% of the khet's area. Clipped east by st.siam and north by st.phaya-thai (both nearer stations ~670-680 m away). Inside: station+exits, Co-Co Walk (60 m), Saphan Hua Chang pier (305 m), Soi 10 night food street (~375 m NW), Rocky Gym (264 m). Partial/edge: Phetchaburi Soi 5 food street (~350-500 m E, near Siam boundary), Pantip Plaza (OSM name not found; Wikipedia says ~10-min walk; sits near the Siam clip - unknown/partial). Outside: Suan Pakkad Palace (~810 m N, Phaya Thai's zone), Santiphap Park (~1.45 km NNE), Baiyoke Tower II (~1.0 km ENE), Platinum Fashion Mall (904 m per OSM), CentralWorld/MBK/BACC (Siam unit), Nang Loeng market (Pom Prap Sattru Phai, unverified - treat unknown), Jim Thompson House (~450 m straight-line but across the canal in Pathum Wan khet and inside Siam's circle - excluded). The 13 mapped temples were not individually identified.

Concrete documented experiences: (1) after-dark eating - Soi 10 vendors 18:00 to 01:00-02:00 in a lane of old shophouses; Soi 5 dinner street 16:00-23:00 described as a neighborhood street, not a tourist attraction (residents/visitors, daily); (2) station-base evenings at Co-Co Walk's inexpensive bars/restaurants popular with locals (Wikipedia), with the adjoining Hollywood Arcade no longer trading; (3) corridor daytime: hotels, apartments and small eating clusters along busy Phetchaburi Rd, with footbridge-crossing guidance for pedestrians; (4) 2025-2026 residents also live through flyover demolition congestion and night-time construction works. Office vs residential: sources document the corridor's hotel/apartment mix but do not distinguish office-block experience - not found.

People value the combination the sources repeatedly name: central location one stop from Siam with a genuinely local, non-touristy street-food scene (Soi 5/Soi 10), at rents below Siam/Chidlom (16,000-30,000 vs 1-bed for newer neighbors), plus a transport stack beyond the single BTS line (bus stops at the exits, canal boat 305 m, ARL one stop north at Phaya Thai). A former resident returning to Bangkok names 'local vibes, restaurants/cafes, super well connected with BTS and Khlong Boats and good cost of living' as why they would return. Mechanism: centrality + price gap to adjacent rated areas + redundancy of transit modes.

Deliberate counter-evidence found: (1) three years of flyover-closure congestion at the unit's core intersection (Jan 2025 - ~Apr 2028) with BMA-flagged severe snarls and mainly-night construction; (2) Phetchaburi Rd as a broad, fast, busy corridor where crossing guidance matters; (3) petty-crime reports concentrate on the adjacent Pratunam belt (alleged bag-slashing 2023; tuk-tuk commission scams), not inside the unit; (4) repeated cleanliness/rat complaints at Soi 5 food street; (5) no named public park inside the catchment on OSM - green is thin (canal walkway, small pitches). Dead-stretches of Phetchaburi: not found documented either way. Old buildings: only indirect evidence (Hollywood Arcade defunct; Soi 10's old two-storey shophouses framed positively).

Day: corridor commerce, cafes and school/office traffic (PropertyScout demographics; Superagent's sidewalk-fruit-vendor mornings). Evening: Soi 5 from 16:00, Co-Co Walk bars, Soi 10 from 18:00 running past midnight (closed Mondays). Night: night-market trading to 01:00-02:00 plus construction works scheduled at night on Phetchaburi (2025-2028). Weekday/weekend split: not documented (not found) apart from Soi 10's Monday closure. Season: only generic monsoon advice (rain gear, shelter during downpours) from the 2026 food guide; Songkran festival period is flagged for pickpocket risk on adjacent-market reports.

BTS Ratchathewi sits just south of the intersection; OSM maps two stairways (refs 1, 2) at the station and sources reference exits 3/4 toward Phetchaburi; a skybridge links to Asia Hotel; escalators down to Co-Co Walk. Bus stops sit 19 m and 52 m from the station ('Ratchathewi Station (Exit 3)' stop; frequency to Phaya Thai snippet-reported at 29+/hour - corroboration only). The Saen Saep boat pier is 305 m away on the canal that bounds the khet. Crossing Phetchaburi/Phaya Thai is via footbridges and controlled crossings per the 2026 guide. Airport Rail Link is one BTS stop north at Phaya Thai. No radius-to-time conversions used; only source-stated walk distances (e.g., Soi 5 '6-minute walk (510 m)' per Visit Thailand Today; Pantip '~10-minute walk' per Wikipedia BTS article).

Groceries: 7-Elevens described as numerous; Big C Extra on Ratchaprarop (position vs clip unknown); no large supermarket confirmed inside the unit. Ordinary food: Soi 5 (daily dinner street, 25-30 baht rice boxes) and Soi 10 (night street to 01:00-02:00) plus corridor eating clusters; PropertyScout adds district eateries (Mandalay Food House, Mono Cafe, Buttery Cafe). Healthcare: no full-service hospital inside the unit on OSM (Decha Hospital 708 m falls in Phaya Thai's zone; Rama/Phyathai 1 named at district level, outside). Gyms: Rocky Gym ~264 m inside; Virgin Active/Fitness First mapped but in Siam's clipped zone; condo gyms (Ideo Q etc.). Co-working: not found in any body-read source (not_found); PropertyScout mentions digital nomads generally.

Housing stock: mid-2010s high-rise condos near the BTS (Ideo Q Ratchathewi, The Line Ratchathewi, Pyne by Sansiri, The Address Siam-Ratchathewi, Villa Ratchatewi, Condolette Ize, Conner Ratchathewi) plus older low-rise; sample characterized as khet-wide listing data. Independent evidence vs app 21,500/38,000: PropertyScout 2025 (1BR 16-30k; 2BR 30-55k), Superagent 2026 (1BR 15-22k; 2BR 28-40k), FazWaz live listings (1BR avg 25.6k, n=1,966; 2BR 40k, n=847; median 25.2k; 641 THB/sqm). The app's numbers are inside every range and modestly below FazWaz asking averages - 'moderate affordability' (rent 6) is consistent; these are asking, not signed, rents, and the khet-wide samples include cheaper Makkasan fringe stock. Period: 2025-2026 data.

The 1.0 ha mapped park could not be identified: OSM shows no named public park inside the clipped catchment, and named candidates all fall outside (Suan Pakkad gardens ~810 m N in Phaya Thai's zone; Pathumwananurak ~850 m E in Siam's; Santiphap ~1.45 km NNE). The only sizable inside polygon checked measures 476 m2. Santiphap Park - honestly checked - is ~1.4-1.5 km NNE (not 1.2 km NW), outside the catchment and beyond even Phaya Thai's circle. Usable green inside is therefore the Saen Saep canal-side walkway (~300 m), small pitches and pocket spaces; BMA '15-minute park' additions in the khet (Nov 2023, district-office posts, snippet-level) could not be pinned to the unit. Green 8 with a 1.0 ha park mapped is in tension with the map evidence: status conflicting until the Overture park layer is checked.

Fits: budget-conscious young professionals, grad students near Mahidol/Chulalongkorn, car-free airport commuters (ARL one stop north), and anyone prioritizing street food over mall dining; also fits people who want Siam's amenities one stop away without Siam rents. Poor fits: households wanting leafy quiet or large green space (no named park inside; 'urban and dense' per Superagent's own cons), families needing international-school proximity (flagged as a gap), light sleepers during 2025-2028 construction nights, and anyone unwilling to cross heavy arterials on foot.

Dated changes: Ratchathewi intersection flyover closed night of 15-16 Jan 2025 for Orange Line works, reconstruction planned Dec 2026-Apr 2028, two lanes each side of Phetchaburi kept open; Pratunam flyover partial demolition Mar 2026, reopen by Nov 2026; MRT Orange Line interchange OR08 targeted ~2030. Development: SHUSH Ratchathewi (Sansiri, 36 ultra-luxury units) ~complete around Aug-Sep 2026; Park Origin Ratchathewi actively listed for rent. Retail churn: Hollywood Arcade adjacent to Co-Co Walk no longer operates as retail; Asia Hotel 'formerly home to the Calypso Cabaret show' (dates unknown). BMA opened '15-minute park' spaces in the khet in Nov 2023 (rooftop park at Phoenix Pratunam; a Phetchaburi-intersection pocket park on 20 Nov 2023 - district-office Facebook, snippet-level, exact positions unverified).

Safety 5 basis: no body-read evidence of a violent-crime or scam pattern specific to the unit was found; documented negatives are traffic/road environment, adjacent-Pratunam petty theft, construction disruption and Soi 5 cleanliness complaints. The score's basis remains unexplained - flag as outside-the-score unknown; single incidents (e.g., the 2023 alleged bag slashing) must not become the label. Transport 10 with one line is mechanistically supported: bus stops at the exits, canal boat 305 m, ARL one stop, future Orange Line interchange - redundancy, not line count. What vibe 10 can mask: three years of flyover-closure congestion and night construction, thin inside green, and a 'local' feel that concentrates in specific sois (Soi 5/10, Co-Co Walk) rather than the whole unit. The 1.0 ha park's identity is unresolved and green 8 rests on unverifiable mapping.

preview.text_en: One BTS stop west of Siam's malls, Ratchathewi trades polish for proximity: dinner streets that open at 16:00 and 18:00 in old shophouse lanes, a canal-boat pier 305 m from the ticket gates, and asking rents several thousand baht below the neighboring rated areas - offset by a flyoverless intersection and three years of Orange Line construction works.

guide_lead.text_en: Ratchathewi is the point where the Sukhumvit line's tourist Bangkok thins out into a district of Phetchaburi Road apartments, hotel rows and neighborhood eating streets. The station sits just south of the Ratchathewi intersection; escalators drop onto Co-Co Walk's inexpensive bars, a skybridge reaches the Asia Hotel, and the Saen Saep express boat leaves from a pier 305 m away toward Pratunam and the Golden Mount. Two food streets anchor the evenings: Soi 5 (16:00-23:00, rice boxes at 25-30 baht) and Soi 10 (18:00 until 01:00-02:00, closed Mondays) in lanes of old two-storey shophouses. Independent 2025-2026 rent data brackets the app's 21,500/38,000 THB figures, below neighboring Siam. The tradeoffs are concrete: no named public park inside the catchment on the maps we checked, a broad arterial to cross on footbridges, and the intersection's flyover gone since January 2025 for the MRT Orange Line, due back around 2028.

strengths.text_en: Transport stack exceeds the single BTS line: bus stops at the exits (19-52 m), canal boat pier at 305 m, Airport Rail Link one stop north, planned Orange Line interchange ~2030 (ratchathewi-c02, ratchathewi-c08)
Distinctly local food streets with documented hours and prices: Soi 5 dinner street 16:00-23:00, Soi 10 night market to 01:00-02:00 (ratchathewi-c05, ratchathewi-c06)
Rents consistently bracketed below neighboring rated areas by three independent 2025-2026 datasets (ratchathewi-c07)
Station-base nightlife for locals rather than tourists at Co-Co Walk (ratchathewi-c03)

tradeoffs.text_en: Flyover demolition at the core intersection from January 2025, reconstruction due by April 2028, with BMA-flagged congestion and mainly-night works (ratchathewi-c09)
No named public park inside the clipped catchment on OSM; the app's 1.0 ha park is unverified and nearest named parks sit 810 m-1.45 km out (ratchathewi-c13)
Phetchaburi Road is a broad, busy arterial where crossing relies on footbridges; pedestrian-risk data not found (ratchathewi-c15)
Petty-crime complaints (alleged bag-slashing, tuk-tuk commission scams) cluster on the adjacent Pratunam belt, not inside the unit (ratchathewi-c10)
Repeated cleanliness/rat complaints at Soi 5 food street, per its own reviewers (ratchathewi-c05)

day_night.text_en: Daytime: corridor commerce and apartment/hotel rows between small eating clusters on Phetchaburi Road (ratchathewi-c15)
Evening from 16:00: Soi 5 dinner street; Co-Co Walk bars at the station base (ratchathewi-c05, ratchathewi-c03)
Late night: Soi 10 trades to 01:00-02:00 (Mondays off), while night construction works run on the corridor through ~2028 (ratchathewi-c06, ratchathewi-c09)

within_area_variation.text_en: Station core: densest mix - exits, skybridge hotel, Co-Co Walk, bus stops, pier within 305 m (ratchathewi-c02, ratchathewi-c03, ratchathewi-c04, ratchathewi-c08)
West/Soi 10 side: old shophouse lanes with the after-dark food market, quieter by day (ratchathewi-c06)
East edge toward Siam: eating clusters thin out and the clip hands ground to the Siam unit (Pantip Plaza and Platinum Mall sit at/beyond the boundary) (ratchathewi-c01)
North edge: hospitals, Phyathai-side development and Suan Pakkad Palace fall into the Phaya Thai unit, not this one (ratchathewi-c11, ratchathewi-c16)

conditional_fit.text_en: Good for car-free commuters: BTS plus boat plus buses plus ARL one stop north (ratchathewi-c08)
Good for budget-conscious professionals and grad students priced out of Siam (ratchathewi-c07)
Poor for green-space seekers: no named park inside; canal walkway and small pitches are the usable green (ratchathewi-c13)
Poor for light sleepers until ~2028: night construction works and intersection congestion (ratchathewi-c09)
Weak for families needing international schools or hospital access inside the unit (ratchathewi-c16)

uncertainties: The identity of the app's 1.0 ha park is unresolved; OSM shows no named public park inside the clipped unit (ratchathewi-c13)
The basis for safety 5 is unexplained: no unit-specific crime pattern found in EN/TH searches; adjacent-Pratunam incidents should not be inherited as a label (ratchathewi-c10)
Bus frequency (29+/hour) and SHUSH Ratchathewi completion rest on snippet-only sources (ratchathewi-c08, ratchathewi-c17)
Inside/partial status of Soi 5 and Pantip Plaza depends on the app's exact clip geometry and could not be settled (ratchathewi-c05)
Reddit comment sentiment was inaccessible; the resident-experience record rests on one post body plus search summaries (ratchathewi-c10 context, source 13)
